title: CROWN version-1 minimum-height certificate
description: The CLI reader and verifier additionally enforce canonical query binding, sorted and in-range occurrence indices, state dependencies, root-state consistency, and the exhaustive lower-bound proof.

query_binding.description: The canonical direct-CQ document for the same catalog and query, with empty initial rows and no updates. Nondefault catalog metadata requires v3; otherwise date/decimal catalogs use v2 and primitive catalogs use v1. Exact canonical equality is checked by the native reader.

minimum_height.description: The claimed minimum native height, or null when the admissible tree family is proved empty.

tree.description: An upper-bound witness at minimum_height, or null for a proved-infeasible nonempty query.

occurrences.description: A nonempty, sorted, unique list of zero-based atom occurrence indices. Sorting and query-relative range are checked by the native verifier.

generalized_allowed.description: Whether generalized roots are allowed in this residual search state.

connex_reachable.description: Whether this state is reachable through the root-connected output region.

bound.description: A positive lower bound no greater than the number of state occurrences, or null to claim that the state has no admissible completion. The bound/occurrence relationship and proof are checked by the native verifier.
